22:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: The Whole Story With Anderson Cooper
Donie O'Sullivan examines how, a decade after MAGA remade the right, President Trump's second term has tested the movement's faithful; from die-hard loyalists to the new generation moving further right, he asks if their loyalty can survive.

23:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Real Time With Bill Maher
Acerbic comic Bill Maher welcomes a panel of guests from diverse parts of the political spectrum for a lively discussion of current events, as well as offering his own perspective on contemporary issues.
